dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Steady 2D geometric narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical irregularities visible on the anterior left lateral margin at the water-skin interface; the right margin appears relatively linear.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform light-grey median intensity, suggestive of a sub-adult pigmentation phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse dark-pixel clusters concentrated primarily along the sagittal axis and around the blowhole periphery.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the light-grey base and the darker mottled clusters.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single high-contrast dark circular mark located on the dorsal midline immediately posterior to the blowhole.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A singular, distinct dark focal mark or pit located on the midline posterior to the blowhole.
